metadata.title: Groupicorn Georgia IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. Local provider groups are considered before named neighboring catchments. Shortlists are editorial discovery candidates, not rankings. Georgia regional hubs remain research gaps when local evidence is thin. September 22, 2026 targeted completion added exact Atlanta and Smyrna program sites from official provider pages; this is not a statewide re-verification.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url uses repository-provided provider brand assets where available. Brand assets are discovery references and have not been license-cleared for redistribution.
metadata.geocoding_note: ZIP codes and street addresses are stored; coordinates intentionally left null in this pass. Geocode later with a chosen provider.

areas.name: Atlanta core / Midtown / Buckhead / Brookhaven
areas.example_cities: Atlanta | Midtown | Buckhead | Brookhaven | Sandy Springs
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Atlanta is split from its north, northeast, and south suburban treatment markets because traffic and provider clustering make them practical separate catchments.

areas.name: Northwest Metro Atlanta
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Cobb and north Fulton treatment locations form a distinct corridor west and north of the Atlanta core.

areas.name: Northeast Metro Atlanta
areas.example_cities: Norcross | Peachtree Corners | Duluth | Lawrenceville | Johns Creek
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Gwinnett and northeast Fulton locations form a practical catchment separate from the northwest corridor.

areas.name: South Metro Atlanta
areas.example_cities: Jonesboro | College Park | East Point | Fayetteville | McDonough
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: South Metro is separated because Clayton, southern Fulton, and Fayette treatment access is not equivalent to north-metro access.

areas.name: Savannah and Coastal Georgia
areas.example_cities: Savannah | Pooler | Garden City | Richmond Hill
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Savannah is an isolated coastal population center; the package keeps it separate rather than implying an Atlanta-area provider is local.

areas.name: Athens and Northeast Georgia
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Athens is a standalone university and regional market. Current pass did not find a sufficiently verified local IOP/PHP shortlist.

areas.name: Augusta and Central Savannah River Area
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Augusta is a standalone cross-border regional hub. This state-specific package does not silently add South Carolina providers.

areas.name: Macon and Middle Georgia
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Macon serves a large central-Georgia region, but no local provider group met the current evidence threshold in this pass.

areas.name: Columbus and Southwest Georgia
areas.example_cities: Columbus | Phenix City | Fort Moore | LaGrange
areas.adjacency_basis: named practical neighboring catchments; not legal or clinical service boundaries
areas.scope_note: Research/display catchment for Groupicorn proximity browsing; not a clinical referral region.
areas.geographic_rationale: Columbus is a standalone west-Georgia hub; cross-border Alabama programs are outside this state-specific package.
